profile.reading: Per EdgeConneX own Phoenix area page, this facility, PHX01, sits near the Arizona State University campus in Tempe, Arizona, about 10 miles from downtown Phoenix. EdgeConneX publishes 79,200 square feet total for the facility, including 17,300 square feet of raised floor for tenant racks, and states the site is ENERGY STAR certified along with HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001 compliance. No IT capacity figure in MW is published for this facility.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] This row was previously exhausted with a company level source only. Fetched EdgeConneX own company page fresh this session, finding the company was founded in 2009, was acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, operates from 3 global headquarters in Northern Virginia, Singapore, and Amsterdam, and states it operates over 90 data centers across Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and South America, with a service range from 40kW to 500MW or more per site. EdgeConneX own Phoenix area page identifies this Tempe location as PHX01 and gave the square footage and certification detail now recorded above. No MW figure was published for this facility. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.
